message.content: I didn't make any trades this turn and ended it with $413 cash. No deal on the table helps me right now. New York Avenue is still unowned, so landing on it is my best chance to finish the orange set. p3's hotels on the light blues are the main risk, so I'm keeping my cash to cover rent.
